reset 1
interval 200
send 20000100
send 2001020000
//Disable standby
send 2F000100
send 2F3F03320100

//GET VDDPA setting
send 20030301A00E

// START CONTINUOUS RF ON (ANTENNA SELF TEST)
send 2F3F03320200

// AST1 - Read Vddpa current (WAIT 0x64 (100us) before reading VDDPA current
send 2F32020864
send 2F32020D64

// STOP CONTINUOUS RF ON
send 2F3F03320000
send 20030301A00E
